main_text.l: Duplicia sunt veluti, Uti possidetis interdictum,

conditio est, nec quisquam præcipuè Reus vel Actor
intelligitur: sed unusquisque tàm Rei quàm Actoris
partes sustinet. §. tertia. inst. cod.

page.notes: The catchword "Quid" at the lower right is the first word of the next page. The black letter German text ("Von straffe ...", "Von des Richters Ampt.") is treated as a German gloss and marked with bl. The first heading block is an italic/roman title; the "Quomodo" and "Quibus" lines are italic subheads. Some letters in the original are worn and uncertain, especially in "Temeritas" and "coercetur", and in the German words; the German text is only partly legible. The line "Duplicia sunt veluti" is a continuation from the previous page. The catchword "Quid" is also printed at the right margin next to the final heading; it appears only once in the transcription as catchword. Printed text is otherwise transcribed as seen.
